workspace.title: Power BI Control Center
workspace.connectedNotice: Configure sources and data flows in Configuration. Analytics uses published warehouse datasets.
workspace.frontendOnlyNotice: Frontend only. No accounts, connected services, saved changes, or live data are available. CSV previews stay in your browser.

studio.panelLoginOnly: To change panels, sign out and choose the panel on the login page.

gis.tilesUnavailable: Some background tiles could not load. Data points remain available; check the network or select the offline background.
gis.label: Location label (optional)
gis.configureHelp: Map published rows using explicit WGS84 latitude (−90 to 90) and longitude (−180 to 180) fields. Map visuals are exploratory drafts; they do not bypass governed-report publication checks.
gis.tilesHelp: Offline mode makes no tile requests. OpenStreetMap downloads background tiles for the visible area; data markers are rendered in your browser.
gis.noCoordinates: No valid mapped coordinates are available. Choose numeric latitude and longitude fields in a published dataset; city names alone are not coordinates.
gis.scope: Shows up to 50 grouped locations from the active published snapshot, with the selected filters. Missing, non-finite, and out-of-range coordinates are excluded.

charts.noDistribution: A distribution chart needs non-negative values and a positive total. View the exact values below or choose a bar or line chart.

polish.reportHelp: Explore published datasets, choose KPIs, and build governed reports.
polish.csvHelp: Upload a file to create a complete replacement snapshot.
polish.cdcHelp: Capture PostgreSQL changes with Debezium and Kafka, then publish a snapshot.
polish.chooseSourceFirst: Choose a source table or upload a CSV file to begin mapping fields.
polish.chooseKeyFirst: Select a stable primary key before creating this flow.

loginPanels.signedOut: You are signed out. Choose Configuration Panel or Report Panel, then sign in with an authorized account.
loginPanels.choose: Which panel do you want to sign in to?
loginPanels.help: Choose your destination after sign-in. Configuration requires the provider role; reports require a data-access grant.

experience.deploymentHelp: Check deployment details and previous verification evidence.
experience.searchHelp: Try another name or clear the status filter.
experience.firstFlowHelp: Choose your source and map its fields, then start capture or upload a CSV snapshot.
experience.saveBeforeTesting: You have unsaved changes. Save these settings before testing the connection.

services.label: Configure services
services.title: Start with your warehouse
services.help: Save your ClickHouse connection. For PostgreSQL CDC, also configure Kafka and Debezium, then run the connection tests.

source.label: Connect a source
source.title: Choose where your data comes from
source.help: Add and test a PostgreSQL connection, or use a CSV file to publish a replacement snapshot.

mapping.label: Map your data
mapping.title: Define your first data flow
mapping.help: Choose a table or CSV source, declare its primary key, and map fields to warehouse types.

publication.label: Publish a snapshot
publication.title: Make your data available for analysis
publication.help: For PostgreSQL, start capture and verify connector status before publishing. For CSV, upload the mapped file. Publication activates a validated snapshot.

journey.completeTitle: Your published data is ready to explore
journey.completeHelp: Choose KPIs, review their mappings and approval, and reconcile results before publishing governed reports.

studio.configurationTitle: From your sources to trusted analytics
studio.configurationDescription: Configure PostgreSQL and CSV sources, map warehouse columns, and publish validated datasets in ClickHouse. PostgreSQL capture uses Debezium and Kafka; publication is a separate, explicit step.
studio.infrastructureHelp: Save your actual service addresses first, then test each service. Empty password fields retain saved credentials.
studio.brokerHelp: CDC requires the Debezium PostgreSQL plugin and a ClickHouse Kafka engine. This initial capture path uses a private PLAINTEXT Kafka connection; TLS/SASL broker configuration is not yet managed here.
studio.secretHelp: Credentials are stored encrypted on the server and are never included in workspace responses. Tests use the saved settings.
studio.warehouseTestSucceeded: ClickHouse connection succeeded. The saved warehouse is accessible.
studio.savedConnectionTestHelp: This test uses saved settings. Save changes before testing.
studio.postgresHelp: Add a read-capable source account. CDC additionally requires logical replication privileges and WAL configuration. No source tables are changed by discovery.
studio.name: Connection name
studio.walReady: PostgreSQL responds and wal_level is logical.
studio.walRequired: PostgreSQL responds, but logical WAL must be enabled before CDC can run.
studio.flowHelp: Define one dataset and its warehouse contract. Database capture is started only after you review and activate the saved flow.
studio.csvHelp: UTF-8, comma-separated, with a header. Limit: 2 MB and 5,000 records per import.
studio.cdcPrerequisites: The first CDC slice supports one table with one primary-key column. The source needs wal_level=logical and a replication-capable account.
studio.mappingHelp: Use Decimal(18,2) for money. Required fields, exact decimal precision and unique CSV keys are validated. Excluded columns are not published. Mapping is fixed after creation; create a new flow for a changed contract.
studio.importSucceeded: CSV validated and published in ClickHouse.
studio.captureHelp: Start provisions dedicated ClickHouse landing objects and a Debezium connector. Kafka capture does not automatically publish data. Publish creates a validated analytical snapshot.
studio.reviewHelp: Only app-owned warehouse objects are created. Existing warehouse tables are not replaced. Capture requires Kafka access from the ClickHouse server.
studio.captureConfigured: Connector configuration accepted. Task health is shown separately; data is not yet published.
studio.publicationHelp: Capture, publication and BI visibility are different. Only snapshots validated and published here appear in Analytics. Failed imports preserve the previous published snapshot.
studio.noFlows: No data flows yet. Create one in Mapping & validation.
studio.analyticsDescription: Build reports from your published ClickHouse datasets. Add charts, KPIs and tables, reorder visuals, and save reports on the server. This workspace queries ClickHouse; Microsoft Power BI delivery is a separate integration.
studio.publishFirst: Import a CSV or configure a PostgreSQL CDC flow, then publish a snapshot. No sample customer data is mixed into this workspace.
studio.emptyCanvas: Add your first visual from the Visualizations pane.
studio.queryHelp: Aggregations run in ClickHouse over the whole published snapshot. At most 50 groups are returned per visual. Up to 12 visuals per report.
studio.noRows: No rows in this published result.

errors.invalid: Check the required fields and identifiers.
errors.requestFailed: The request failed. Check the service settings and retry.
errors.postgresUnavailable: PostgreSQL could not be queried. Check its address, account, network and TLS certificate.
errors.warehouseUnavailable: ClickHouse did not complete the request. Check its URL, database, privileges and schema.
errors.warehouseMissing: Save the ClickHouse URL and existing database first.
errors.kafkaMissing: Save the Kafka Connect URL first.
errors.kafkaUnavailable: Kafka Connect could not complete the request. Check its address and worker logs.
errors.pluginMissing: The Debezium PostgreSQL plugin is not installed on Kafka Connect.
errors.connectorInvalid: Kafka Connect rejected the source configuration. Check replication permissions and the connector worker logs.
errors.csvLimit: CSV limit exceeded: 2 MB and 5,000 rows per import.
errors.csvInvalid: CSV is invalid. Use unique headers, matching columns and correctly quoted comma-separated values.
errors.qualityFailed: Quality validation failed. Required fields, exact numeric types or row counts do not match. Previous published data is unchanged.
errors.duplicateKey: The file has an empty or repeated primary key. Each row needs one stable unique key.
errors.mappingMismatch: The source fields no longer match the saved mapping. Create a flow for the changed schema.
errors.singleKeyRequired: This CDC slice requires a table with one primary-key column included in the mapping.
errors.noCapturedData: No Kafka events have landed in ClickHouse yet. Check connector tasks and ClickHouse Kafka consumers before publishing.
errors.notPublished: This dataset has no published snapshot.
errors.notFound: The requested workspace item was not found.
errors.invalidIdentifier: Warehouse names must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers and underscores.
errors.importFailed: The import failed; the previous published snapshot remains available.
errors.storeInvalid: Workspace metadata cannot be read. Restore its metadata and encryption key together.
errors.originRejected: This request origin is not allowed.
errors.schemaChanged: The mapped source schema changed. Review its fields and create a new versioned flow; the previous published snapshot remains available.
errors.infrastructureInUse: Published or capturing flows depend on these service addresses. Keep the service identity stable; credentials can still be rotated.
errors.flowBusy: An operation for this flow is already running. Wait for it to finish before retrying.
errors.forbidden: This operation requires the provider role.
errors.dataAccessRequired: This account has no grant to view customer data. Use an authorized customer account or an explicitly granted provider account.
errors.passwordLength: Use a password between 12 and 128 characters.
errors.setupDenied: Setup is already complete or the one-time server key is incorrect.
errors.loginLimited: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes before retrying.
errors.metricUnsupported: This KPI needs a model that is not supported yet.
errors.metricCurrency: Money KPIs require a mapped Decimal(18,2) amount and a three-letter currency code.
errors.definitionRequired: Write an explicit business definition of at least 30 characters.
errors.metricNotReady: Publication is blocked: every visual must use an approved KPI reconciled against the current published data version.
errors.reconciliationFailed: The warehouse result does not match the independent control total within the allowed tolerance. Publication remains blocked.
errors.backendUnavailable: This action requires a backend, which is not included in this project.

studio.setupHelp: First-time setup is protected by a one-time key. Read .data/bootstrap.key on the application server, then choose your username and a password of at least 12 characters. The key is removed after setup.
studio.signInHelp: Provider accounts configure the data platform. Customer accounts use the analytics workspace. Permissions are checked on the server.
studio.bootstrapDataAccess: I am authorized by this organization to grant this initial pilot administrator access to customer analytical data.
studio.pilotUsersHelp: Create named local accounts. Customer accounts can analyze published data but cannot change infrastructure or approve definitions. Provider data access is an explicit grant, not a default.
studio.grantProviderData: Explicitly grant this provider account customer-data access

metric.title: Choose and validate your KPIs
metric.help: Start with a business question, not a chart. Map an available dataset, document the definition, obtain provider review, and reconcile the result against an independent control total before generating a publishable dashboard.
metric.noPublishedDataset: No published dataset is available yet. In Data Flows, publish a captured dataset after its quality checks pass, then return here to configure the KPI. Requesting a KPI only adds it to the setup queue.
metric.definitionHelp: At least 30 characters. Explain what one row means and how refunds, taxes, discounts, cancelled records and currency are handled. The application does not infer these accounting rules. Money measures require Decimal(18,2).
metric.unsupportedHelp: This KPI is not executable in the current slice. It needs approved multi-entity joins, history or accounting rules. Missing fields and definitions will not be invented to produce a number.
metric.generateHelp: Select ready, reconciled KPIs. The generated draft uses their approved formulas; it is not published until you explicitly publish it.

record_count.name: Published record count
record_count.definition: Count warehouse rows at the declared grain. This is not automatically a count of customers or orders.

customer_count.name: Distinct customers in the dataset
customer_count.definition: Count distinct approved customer identifiers in the published dataset. No new/active/retained-customer definition is assumed.

order_count.name: Distinct orders
order_count.definition: Count distinct approved order identifiers. Inclusion and cancellation policies require review.

sales_amount.name: Approved sales amount
sales_amount.definition: Sum the mapped exact-decimal amount under an explicitly reviewed business definition and one declared currency.

average_order_value.name: Average order value
average_order_value.definition: Approved amount sum divided by distinct order count. Requires compatible grain and explicit financial exclusions.

completed_revenue.name: Completed sales revenue
completed_revenue.definition: Requires approved orders/payment relationships, eligible statuses, refund rules and payment dates.

gross_margin.name: Gross margin
gross_margin.definition: Requires approved net revenue, cost of goods, reconciliation and accounting treatment.

retention.name: Customer retention
retention.definition: Requires cohort periods, historical coverage and an approved retained-customer definition.

net_profit.name: Net profit
net_profit.definition: Requires a reconciled accounting model, approved income/expense classifications and adjustments.

metric.requestHelp: You can request a KPI before any source is connected. The provider can see the request and arrange missing data or modeling; requesting it never makes an unsupported metric executable.
metric.requestPending: KPI requested. Data, mappings or approved definitions still need to be supplied.

studio.reportDegraded: Needs attention: KPI validation is no longer current for this data version.
studio.overviewHint: Actual setup, flow and publication status

dataBrowser.title: Browse published data
dataBrowser.description: Inspect the mapped rows in the active published ClickHouse snapshot. Source tables and unpublished raw events are not shown here.
dataBrowser.limit: 50 rows per page; browsing is limited to the first 100,000 rows.
dataBrowser.emptyHelp: Import a CSV or finish PostgreSQL capture and publish a snapshot. The table stays empty until a real warehouse query is available.

pipeline.description: These counts come from your saved workspace. Configuring a connector, publishing data and publishing a dashboard are separate steps.
pipeline.sourcesHelp: Saved connections; not a live health guarantee.
pipeline.captureHelp: Check task health in Data flows before treating capture as running.
pipeline.publishedHelp: Validated snapshots with an active load ID.
pipeline.reportsHelp: Reports that passed the publication gate.

dockerState.accessible: Socket accessible; service health not checked

pipeline.permissionHelp: The local stack cannot start from this session because the Docker socket denies access. An administrator must run this on the host:
pipeline.permissionNote: Enter the sudo password only in your terminal. Refresh this panel after the change; it does not start containers automatically.
pipeline.verified: Local stack verification evidence recorded at {time}.
pipeline.unverified: No successful end-to-end verification evidence is recorded. No live Docker pipeline is claimed.
pipeline.verificationNote: Recorded evidence is historical and is not a live service-health check. Port 3003 uses its own local workspace; its records are separate from this workspace.
pipeline.noFlows: No flow has been configured in this workspace. Start with Infrastructure, Sources, then Mapping and validation.
pipeline.localCredentials: Use its local accounts from .data/compose-access.txt. This workspace and its accounts remain separate.

studio.sampleDataNotice: Sample data is enabled. SAMPLE charts and rows are fictional and demonstrate the app; they are not live Power BI or database data. Sample reports are exploratory drafts.
